title: 第四章 去年你也说过要离婚
content_zh:
宣云溪有一瞬间的惊讶——霍廷深舍不得自己受伤吗？

    但下一秒，她就嘲笑自己自作多情了。

    霍廷深这人，和大多数权贵阶层的男人一样，都有点大男子主义。

    他们坏的一面是霸道强势，好的一面是遇到危险时会有“我是男的我得挡在女人前面”的思维。

    换而言之，霍廷深只是因为丈夫这个身份才替她挡一下，哪怕他厌恶自己。

    见想打的人没打到，霍老太太眯起眼睛，“廷深，你胆子肥了，我教训人你都敢阻止。”

    霍廷深被打的那块皮肤火辣辣地疼，但他没表现出什么，只是道：“霍家的男人不会眼睁睁看着女人挨打。”

    霍老太太审视地看着霍廷深。

    她一方面想打宣云溪，一方面不允许自己的子孙后辈没担当，所以没反驳，只是道：“你倒是把家训背牢了。”

    霍廷深没理会老太太的讽刺，扭头对杜嫂道：“你送老太太回去，这件事我自己处理。”

    见状，霍老太太眯着眼看了看他，她是个强势又能干的人，当初霍老爷子去世，儿子儿媳妇在部队里回不来，孙子年龄尚小，她独自把霍氏集团做到了本省第一，是出了名的女强人。

    可从那开始公司就止步不前了，后来霍廷深接手公司，在短短几年把公司做到全国第一，完成了普通人难以企及的大突破，被评为绝顶天才。

    就因为这个，霍老太太在面对别人时绝对强势，对霍廷深却多有不同。

    “那你就管好这个女人！”

    语气不善地说完这话，霍老太太转身离开，屋子里只剩下他们一家四口，气氛有些僵硬。

    霍逸和霍灵在霍老太太在的时候大气都不敢喘一口，现在吓人的老太太走了，他们连忙跑过去关心爸爸。

    霍逸看着霍廷深脖子上那条刺眼的红痕，认真地说‘要涂药膏，不然会感染’，而霍灵则是搂住霍廷深的脖子，要给爸爸呼呼，呼呼痛痛飞走。

    两个孩子明显和亲爹相处更自然，宣云溪不禁心情复杂，自己这个亲妈好像真做得很不到位？

    “这点小伤不需要涂药，你们不用担心。”
content_en:
Xuanyunxi was surprised for a moment - was Huo Ting reluctant to get hurt?

    But the next second, she laughed at herself for being so sentimental.

    Huo Tingshen, like most men in the powerful class, is a bit chauvinistic.

    Their bad side is that they are domineering and strong, and their good side is that when they encounter danger, they have the mentality of "I am a man and I have to stand in front of women."

    In other words, Huo Tingshen only blocked her because of her husband's identity, even if he hated himself.

    Seeing that the person she wanted to hit was not hit, Mrs. Huo narrowed her eyes and said, "Ting Shen, you are so courageous. You dare to stop me even if I teach you a lesson."

    Huo Tingshen's beaten skin hurt, but he didn't show anything. He just said: "The men of the Huo family will not watch women being beaten."

    Mrs. Huo looked at Huo Tingshen critically.

    On the one hand, she wanted to fight Xuan Yunxi, but on the other hand, she did not allow her descendants to fail to take responsibility, so she did not refute, but just said: "You have memorized the family motto well."

    Huo Ting ignored the old lady's sarcasm and turned to Mrs. Du: "You send the old lady back, I will handle this matter myself."

    Seeing this, Mrs. Huo narrowed her eyes and looked at him. She was a strong and capable person. When Mr. Huo passed away, her son and daughter-in-law could not come back from the army, and her grandson was still young. She single-handedly made the Huo Group number one in the province, and she was known as a strong woman.

    But from then on, the company stalled. Later, Huo Tingshen took over the company and made the company number one in the country in just a few years. He completed a breakthrough that was difficult for ordinary people to achieve and was rated as a top genius.

    Because of this, Mrs. Huo is absolutely strong when facing others, but she is very different towards Huo Tingshen.

    "Then take care of this woman!"

    After saying this in a bad tone, Mrs. Huo turned and left. There were only four of them left in the room, and the atmosphere was a bit stiff.

    Huo Yi and Huo Ling didn't dare to take a breath when the old lady Huo was there. Now that the scary old lady was gone, they hurried over to care about their father.

    Huo Yi looked at the dazzling red mark on Huo Tingshen's neck and said seriously, 'You need to apply ointment, otherwise it will get infected.' Huo Ling put her arms around Huo Tingshen's neck and wanted to scream for his father, but he flew away in pain.

    The two children obviously get along more naturally with their biological father. Xuan Yunxi can't help but feel complicated. It seems that her biological mother is really not doing a good job?

    "This minor injury does not require any medicine, so you don't have to worry."
title_en: Chapter 4 You also said you wanted a divorce last year
